mechanism.claim: Within a completed six-hour BTC auction, a middle-phase one-sided break of the opening two-hour range that closes back inside, followed by a final-phase move through the opening-range midpoint opposite the break, is a confirmed failed auction rather than an unfinished breakout. In high realized variation, follow the confirmed failure direction for six elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: short after an upper opening-range failure and long after a lower opening-range failure
mechanism.why_distinct: LEMRR uses the ordering of full-day absolute extremes at Tuesday/Friday boundaries. Range-boundary and Donchian candidates use trailing historical ranges. HVORFR defines a fresh within-block opening range, an exclusive middle-phase excursion, an inside close, and a separate final midpoint confirmation at two daily clocks; no prior event or control is reused.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed six-hour realized-variation causal rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: two conditional 06:05/18:05 UTC failed-auction clocks are absent from Gross9

features.blocks: exact [00:00,06:00) and [12:00,18:00) UTC blocks of 72 coherent completed 5m bars
features.opening_phase: first 24 bars; opening_high=max(high), opening_low=min(low), midpoint=(high+low)/2, strict positive range
features.middle_phase: next 24 bars; exactly one of middle_high>opening_high or middle_low<opening_low; middle final close strictly inside opening range
features.final_phase: last 24 bars; final return strict opposite break direction and final close strictly beyond opening midpoint in that direction
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared 72 completed 5m open-to-close log returns)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 252 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact 06:00 or 18:00 UTC after block completes
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; exact funding after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.live_extension: read-only Postgres BTCUSDT 1m through 2026-08-01 with exact overlap parity
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no block, phase, range, confirmation, rank, variation, side, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
